level.title: Hindi C2 — Semantic, Rhetorical, and Stylistic Mastery
goals: Control information structure and ethical persuasion.
Negotiate and recast meaning across high-stakes genres.

lessons.title: Semantic Precision and What Remains Unsaid
lessons.learn: Distinguish asserted content from presupposition and invited inference. Select near-synonyms according to evidence strength, focus, and speaker intention; explain what a formulation commits the speaker to.

grammar.title: Scope, focus, and implication
grammar.explain: मात्र and ही restrict alternatives but attach to different constituents in context. आँकड़े सुझाते हैं is weaker than आँकड़े दर्शाते हैं and far weaker than सिद्ध करते हैं. A presupposition is treated as background; an implication may be inferred without being literally asserted.
grammar.pattern: focused constituent + ही; मात्र + restricted category; evidence + commitment-calibrated verb

examples.t: आँकड़े सुधार सुझाते हैं, पर उसका कारण नहीं दर्शाते।
examples.r: ā̃kṛe sudhār sujhāte haĩ, par uskā kāraṇ nahī̃ darśāte.
examples.en: The figures suggest improvement but do not demonstrate its cause.

examples.t: समस्या मात्र धन की नहीं, भरोसे की भी है।
examples.r: samasyā mātra dhan kī nahī̃, bharose kī bhī hai.
examples.en: The problem is not merely money; it is also trust.

examples.t: समिति ने ही निर्णय लिया था।
examples.r: samiti ne hī nirṇay liyā thā.
examples.en: It was the committee itself that made the decision.

mistakes: In Semantic Precision and What Remains Unsaid, grammatical possibility is not enough: preserve the intended meaning, relationship, evidence strength, and discourse purpose.

dialogue.t: “उसने फिर शिकायत की” में कौन-सी पूर्वधारणा है?
dialogue.r: “usne phir śikāyat kī” mẽ kaun-sī pūrvadhāraṇā hai?
dialogue.en: What presupposition occurs in “She complained again”?

dialogue.t: कि वह पहले भी शिकायत कर चुकी थी; यह नया दावा नहीं, पृष्ठभूमि की तरह रखा गया है।
dialogue.r: ki vah pahle bhī śikāyat kar cukī thī; yah nayā dāvā nahī̃, pṛṣṭhabhūmi kī tarah rakhā gayā hai.
dialogue.en: That she had complained before; it is presented as background, not the new claim.

dialogue.t: और “समिति ने ही” का निहितार्थ?
dialogue.r: aur “samiti ne hī” kā nihitārth?
dialogue.en: And the implication of “the committee itself”?

dialogue.t: प्रासंगिक अन्य पक्षों ने निर्णय नहीं लिया—यही विरोधी विकल्प हटाया गया है।
dialogue.r: prāsaṅgik anya pakṣõ ne nirṇay nahī̃ liyā—yahī virodhī vikalp haṭāyā gayā hai.
dialogue.en: Other relevant parties did not decide—the contrasting alternatives are excluded.

practice.q: Use the verb that avoids claiming demonstration.
practice.answer: सुझाना

practice.q: Focus the committee: समिति ने ___ निर्णय लिया।
practice.answer: ही

practice.q: Infer the presupposition of उसने फिर प्रश्न उठाया.
practice.answer: She had raised a question before.

practice.q: Translate with restrictive focus: “The issue is not merely cost.”
practice.answer: मुद्दा मात्र लागत का नहीं है।

practice.q: Explain the commitment difference among suggest, show, and prove in Hindi.
practice.answer: सुझाना संभावित निष्कर्ष देता है; दर्शाना उसे स्पष्ट साक्ष्य से सामने रखता है; सिद्ध करना निर्णायक प्रमाण का दावा करता है।

quiz.q: Which meaning best fits सुझाना?
quiz.why: सुझाना means to suggest in this lesson.

quiz.q: Which meaning best fits दर्शाना?
quiz.why: दर्शाना means to demonstrate/show.

quiz.q: Which expression means “implication”?
quiz.why: निहितार्थ carries that meaning.

quiz.q: What is the key advanced distinction in semantic scope?
options: meaning, evidence, or register in context
quiz.why: C-level control depends on contextual meaning and discourse effect.

quiz.q: Which response demonstrates C2 control in “Semantic Precision and What Remains Unsaid”?
options: a literal translation regardless of context
a coherent choice justified by stance and audience
quiz.why: Precision and audience-sensitive justification are required.

lessons.title: Information Structure and Strategic Emphasis
lessons.learn: Control given/new information, contrastive topic तो, exclusive ही, additive/even भी, and marked order. Marked order is successful only when listeners can recover the intended alternatives and focus.

vocab.en: as far as the question is concerned

grammar.title: Particles and discourse prominence
grammar.explain: खर्च तो घटा, पर समय बढ़ा concedes or foregrounds the cost claim before contrast. समिति ने ही focuses the actor; समिति ने यही निर्णय लिया focuses the selected decision. भी may add an alternative or, under suitable context, create an “even” reading.
grammar.pattern: contrastive topic + तो + comment; focused constituent + ही

examples.t: खर्च तो घटा, लेकिन प्रतीक्षा का समय बढ़ गया।
examples.r: kharc to ghaṭā, lekin pratīkṣā kā samay baṛh gayā.
examples.en: Costs did fall, but waiting time increased.

examples.t: यही निष्कर्ष उपलब्ध प्रमाण से निकलता है।
examples.r: yahī niṣkarṣ upalabdh pramāṇ se nikaltā hai.
examples.en: This very conclusion follows from the available evidence.

examples.t: कम अनुभवी सदस्य ने भी आपत्ति पहचान ली।
examples.r: kam anubhavī sadasya ne bhī āpatti pahcān lī.
examples.en: Even the less experienced member noticed the objection.

mistakes: In Information Structure and Strategic Emphasis, grammatical possibility is not enough: preserve the intended meaning, relationship, evidence strength, and discourse purpose.

dialogue.t: प्रस्तुति की शुरुआत निष्कर्ष से करूँ या पृष्ठभूमि से?
dialogue.r: prastuti kī śuruāt niṣkarṣ se karū̃ yā pṛṣṭhabhūmi se?
dialogue.en: Should I begin the presentation with the conclusion or background?

dialogue.t: श्रोताओं को जितनी पृष्ठभूमि चाहिए उतनी दें, फिर नई बात पर प्रमुखता रखें।
dialogue.r: śrotāõ ko jitnī pṛṣṭhabhūmi cāhie utnī dẽ, phir naī bāt par pramukhtā rakhẽ.
dialogue.en: Give listeners as much background as they need, then emphasize the new information.

dialogue.t: “लागत तो घटी” से क्या प्रभाव पड़ेगा?
dialogue.r: “lāgat to ghaṭī” se kyā prabhāv paṛegā?
dialogue.en: What effect will “costs did fall” have?

dialogue.t: आप उस लाभ को स्वीकार करके उसके बाद की सीमा को अधिक प्रभावी बनाते हैं।
dialogue.r: āp us lābh ko svīkār karke uske bād kī sīmā ko adhik prabhāvī banāte haĩ.
dialogue.en: You concede that benefit and make the following limitation more effective.

practice.q: Which particle creates a contrastive topic?
practice.answer: तो

practice.q: Focus this specific result: ___ निष्कर्ष.
practice.answer: यही

practice.q: Order discourse moves: evidence, context, consequence, focal contrast.
practice.answer: context → focal contrast → evidence → consequence

practice.q: Translate with contrastive topic: “Quality did improve, but access declined.”
practice.answer: गुणवत्ता तो सुधरी, लेकिन पहुँच घट गई।

practice.q: Explain how moving ही changes focus in two Hindi examples.
practice.answer: समिति ने ही कहा focuses who spoke; समिति ने यही कहा focuses what was said.

lessons.title: Rhetoric, Counterargument, and Ethical Persuasion
lessons.learn: Persuade without laundering opinion into fact. State a position, present the strongest fair objection, concede valid limits, rebut with evidence, and issue a proportionate recommendation.

grammar.title: Concession–rebuttal architecture
grammar.explain: हमारा मत है कि transparently marks institutional judgment. अलबत्ता grants a point without surrendering the thesis. A fair rebuttal answers the strongest plausible objection; a recommendation must not outrun the evidence or conceal affected stakeholders.
grammar.pattern: position → fair objection/concession → warranted rebuttal → proportionate recommendation

examples.t: हमारा मत है कि प्रस्ताव को अस्वीकार करने के बजाय संशोधित किया जाए।
examples.r: hamārā mat hai ki prastāv ko asvīkār karne ke bajāy saṃśodhit kiyā jāe.
examples.en: Our position is that the proposal should be revised rather than rejected.

examples.t: अलबत्ता, प्रारंभिक लागत अधिक होगी; फिर भी दीर्घकालीन बचत महत्त्वपूर्ण है।
examples.r: alabattā, prārambhik lāgat adhik hogī; phir bhī dīrghakālīn bacat mahattvapūrṇ hai.
examples.en: Admittedly initial cost will be higher; nevertheless long-term savings matter.

examples.t: यह अनुशंसा उपलब्ध प्रमाण की सीमा के अनुरूप है।
examples.r: yah anuśaṃsā upalabdh pramāṇ kī sīmā ke anurūp hai.
examples.en: This recommendation is proportionate to the limits of available evidence.

mistakes: In Rhetoric, Counterargument, and Ethical Persuasion, grammatical possibility is not enough: preserve the intended meaning, relationship, evidence strength, and discourse purpose.

dialogue.t: लेख कहता है कि विरोधियों को समस्या समझ ही नहीं आई।
dialogue.r: lekh kahtā hai ki virodhiyõ ko samasyā samajh hī nahī̃ āī.
dialogue.en: The article says opponents simply failed to understand the problem.

dialogue.t: यह उनके तर्क का अनुचित सरलीकरण है। मैं उनकी सबसे मजबूत आपत्ति रखूँगा।
dialogue.r: yah unke tark kā anucit saralīkaraṇ hai. maĩ unkī sabse mazbūt āpatti rakhū̃gā.
dialogue.en: That unfairly simplifies their argument. I will present their strongest objection.

dialogue.t: फिर निष्कर्ष कैसे बचाएँगे?
dialogue.r: phir niṣkarṣ kaise bacāẽge?
dialogue.en: Then how will you defend the conclusion?

dialogue.t: आपत्ति की मान्य सीमा स्वीकार करूँगा, फिर सप्रमाण उत्तर और सीमित अनुशंसा दूँगा।
dialogue.r: āpatti kī mānya sīmā svīkār karū̃gā, phir sapramāṇ uttar aur sīmit anuśaṃsā dū̃gā.
dialogue.en: I will accept its valid limit, then provide an evidence-based answer and a limited recommendation.

practice.q: What does हमारा मत है कि signal?
practice.answer: It openly marks the proposition as an institutional position.

practice.q: Which word introduces a concession?
practice.answer: अलबत्ता

practice.q: Order: recommendation, objection, position, rebuttal.
practice.answer: position → objection/concession → rebuttal → recommendation

practice.q: Formalize responsibly: “This plan will definitely solve everything.”
practice.answer: उपलब्ध प्रमाण से लगता है कि यह योजना समस्या के कुछ प्रमुख पक्षों को कम कर सकती है।

practice.q: Respond to a strong cost objection without caricaturing it.
practice.answer: प्रारंभिक लागत संबंधी आपत्ति उचित है। तथापि चरणबद्ध कार्यान्वयन से जोखिम सीमित किया जा सकता है; इसलिए पहले नियंत्रित परीक्षण की अनुशंसा है।

quiz.q: Which meaning best fits हमारा मत है कि?
quiz.why: हमारा मत है कि means our position is that in this lesson.

quiz.q: Which meaning best fits संभावित आपत्ति?
quiz.why: संभावित आपत्ति means possible objection.

quiz.q: Which expression means “acknowledged limitation”?
quiz.why: मान्य सीमा carries that meaning.

quiz.q: What is the key advanced distinction in ethical persuasion?
options: meaning, evidence, or register in context
quiz.why: C-level control depends on contextual meaning and discourse effect.

options: a literal translation regardless of context
a coherent choice justified by stance and audience
quiz.why: Precision and audience-sensitive justification are required.

lessons.title: Scholarly Synthesis and Faithful Reformulation
lessons.learn: Integrate multiple sources while preserving their distinct claims, methods, and degrees of certainty. Reformulate dense prose without strengthening, flattening, or falsely reconciling disagreement.

grammar.title: Source relation and qualification
grammar.explain: समग्रतः summarizes a body of evidence but permits variation. इसका आशय यह नहीं कि blocks an overbroad inference. A synthesis identifies whether sources agree, qualify, address different populations, or genuinely conflict; it does not merely list summaries.
grammar.pattern: source A claim + source B relation + scope/limitation + warranted synthesis

examples.t: समग्रतः परिणाम सकारात्मक हैं; इसका आशय यह नहीं कि प्रत्येक समूह को समान लाभ मिला।
examples.r: samagrataḥ pariṇām sakārātmak haĩ; iskā āśay yah nahī̃ ki pratyek samūh ko samān lābh milā.
examples.en: Overall results are positive; this does not mean every group benefited equally.

examples.t: पहला अध्ययन प्रभाव दर्शाता है, जबकि दूसरा उसके प्रमाणाधार की सीमा बताता है।
examples.r: pahlā adhyayan prabhāv darśātā hai, jabki dūsrā uske pramāṇādhār kī sīmā batātā hai.
examples.en: The first study demonstrates an effect, while the second identifies limits in its evidence base.

examples.t: दोनों निष्कर्ष विरोधी नहीं; वे अलग आबादियों से संबंधित हैं।
examples.r: donõ niṣkarṣ virodhī nahī̃; ve alag ābādiyõ se saṃbandhit haĩ.
examples.en: The conclusions are not contradictory; they concern different populations.

mistakes: In Scholarly Synthesis and Faithful Reformulation, grammatical possibility is not enough: preserve the intended meaning, relationship, evidence strength, and discourse purpose.

dialogue.t: आपने दोनों अध्ययनों को एक ही निष्कर्ष का समर्थन करने वाला बताया है।
dialogue.r: āpne donõ adhyayanõ ko ek hī niṣkarṣ kā samarthan karne vālā batāyā hai.
dialogue.en: You said both studies support the same conclusion.

dialogue.t: यह ठीक नहीं; दूसरे अध्ययन में प्रभाव केवल छोटे संस्थानों में मिला।
dialogue.r: yah ṭhīk nahī̃; dūsre adhyayan mẽ prabhāv keval choṭe saṃsthānõ mẽ milā.
dialogue.en: That is inaccurate; the second study found the effect only in small institutions.

dialogue.t: तो पुनःसूत्रण में क्या बदलेंगे?
dialogue.r: to punaḥsūtraṇ mẽ kyā badlẽge?
dialogue.en: What will you change in the reformulation?

dialogue.t: साझा दिशा बताऊँगा, पर आबादी, पद्धति और निश्चितता का अंतर सुरक्षित रखूँगा।
dialogue.r: sājhā diśā batāū̃gā, par ābādī, paddhati aur niścittā kā antar surakṣit rakhū̃gā.
dialogue.en: I will state the shared direction but preserve differences in population, method, and certainty.

practice.q: Which move blocks an overgeneralized inference?
practice.answer: इसका आशय यह नहीं कि…

practice.q: Complete: conclusions concern different populations, so they are not necessarily ___.
practice.answer: विरोधी

practice.q: Explain समग्रतः without erasing exceptions.
practice.answer: It marks an overall pattern while allowing variation and exceptions.

practice.q: Translate: “The sources converge on direction but differ in certainty.”
practice.answer: स्रोत दिशा के विषय में सहमत हैं, पर निष्कर्ष की निश्चितता में भिन्न हैं।

practice.q: Synthesize one positive finding and one methodological limitation.

lessons.title: Figurative Language, Irony, and Cultural Inference
lessons.learn: Interpret idiom, irony, and extended metaphor by combining linguistic cues with genre and cultural context. Defend an interpretation while distinguishing conventional meaning from a creative extension.

vocab.en: for a plan/scheme not to succeed
to confront with an uncomfortable truth

grammar.title: Literal proposition versus rhetorical effect
grammar.explain: दाल न गलना conventionally describes an attempt that fails, not cooking. आईना दिखाना can frame criticism as necessary truth-telling and therefore carries evaluation. Irony depends on a mismatch between wording and context/prosody; do not label every negative statement sarcastic.
grammar.pattern: literal wording + contextual mismatch/convention → rhetorical interpretation + evidence

examples.t: इस बार दबाव डालने की उनकी दाल नहीं गली।
examples.r: is bār dabāv ḍālne kī unkī dāl nahī̃ galī.
examples.en: This time their attempt to exert pressure did not succeed.

examples.t: व्यंग्यकार ने व्यवस्था को आईना दिखाया।
examples.r: vyaṅgyakār ne vyavasthā ko āīnā dikhāyā.
examples.en: The satirist confronted the system with an uncomfortable truth.

examples.t: श्रोता की नब्ज़ पहचाने बिना भाषण प्रभावी नहीं होगा।
examples.r: śrotā kī nabz pahcāne binā bhāṣaṇ prabhāvī nahī̃ hogā.
examples.en: The speech will not be effective without understanding the audience’s mood.

mistakes: In Figurative Language, Irony, and Cultural Inference, grammatical possibility is not enough: preserve the intended meaning, relationship, evidence strength, and discourse purpose.

dialogue.t: कहानी में पात्र हर संकट पर कहता है, “वाह, क्या शानदार व्यवस्था है!”
dialogue.r: kahānī mẽ pātra har saṅkaṭ par kahtā hai, “vāh, kyā śāndār vyavasthā hai!”
dialogue.en: In the story the character says at every crisis, “Wow, what a wonderful system!”

dialogue.t: शाब्दिक प्रशंसा और लगातार विफलता का विरोध विडंबना बनाता है।
dialogue.r: śābdik praśaṃsā aur lagātār viphaltā kā virodh viḍambanā banātā hai.
dialogue.en: The contrast between literal praise and repeated failure creates irony.

dialogue.t: क्या केवल वाक्य देखकर यह निष्कर्ष निकलता?
dialogue.r: kyā keval vākya dekhkar yah niṣkarṣ nikaltā?
dialogue.en: Could that conclusion follow from the sentence alone?

dialogue.t: नहीं, कथानक, दोहराव और सम्भावित स्वर—तीनों संकेतार्थ तय करते हैं।
dialogue.r: nahī̃, kathānak, dohrāv aur sambhāvit svar—tīnõ saṅketārth tay karte haĩ.
dialogue.en: No; plot, repetition, and likely tone jointly determine the suggested meaning.

practice.q: Interpret: उनकी दाल नहीं गली.
practice.answer: Their scheme or attempt did not succeed.

practice.q: Which idiom means understanding public mood?
practice.answer: नब्ज़ पहचानना

practice.q: The mismatch between praise and failure may create ___.
practice.answer: विडंबना

practice.q: Neutralize: व्यंग्यकार ने व्यवस्था को आईना दिखाया.
practice.answer: व्यंग्यकार ने व्यवस्था की असुविधाजनक वास्तविकताओं को स्पष्ट किया।

practice.q: Defend an ironic reading using three contextual cues.
practice.answer: शाब्दिक प्रशंसा संकट के विपरीत है, वही वाक्य बार-बार आता है, और पात्र के अनुभव से सकारात्मक अर्थ असंगत है; इसलिए पंक्ति विडंबनापूर्ण है।

lessons.title: High-Stakes Negotiation and Stylistic Recasting
lessons.learn: Integrate evidence, face management, hidden interests, conditional agreement, formal minutes, and public explanation. Preserve conditions and dissent when moving across spoken, institutional, and audience-facing genres.

grammar.title: Invariant proposition, adaptive register
grammar.explain: सशर्त सहमति is not सर्वसम्मति: the condition remains part of the commitment. Spoken negotiation may be relational and exploratory; minutes must identify actor, condition, decision, and dissent; public explanation can unpack technical wording without changing modal force.
grammar.pattern: spoken proposal ↔ minutes record ↔ public explanation, with conditions preserved

examples.t: स्वतंत्र समीक्षा की शर्त पर हम सशर्त सहमति दे सकते हैं।
examples.r: svatantra samīkṣā kī śart par ham saśart sahmati de sakte haĩ.
examples.en: We can give conditional agreement subject to an independent review.

examples.t: दो हितधारकों ने समय-सीमा पर असहमति दर्ज की।
examples.r: do hitadhārakõ ne samay-sīmā par asahmati darj kī.
examples.en: Two stakeholders recorded dissent regarding the deadline.

examples.t: संक्षेप में, प्रस्ताव गति और जवाबदेही में संतुलन चाहता है।
examples.r: saṃkṣep mẽ, prastāv gati aur javābdehī mẽ saṃtulan cāhtā hai.
examples.en: In brief, the proposal seeks to balance speed and accountability.

mistakes: In High-Stakes Negotiation and Stylistic Recasting, grammatical possibility is not enough: preserve the intended meaning, relationship, evidence strength, and discourse purpose.

dialogue.t: किस शर्त पर आप प्रस्ताव का समर्थन कर सकते हैं?
dialogue.r: kis śart par āp prastāv kā samarthan kar sakte haĩ?
dialogue.en: Under what condition can you support the proposal?

dialogue.t: समीक्षा के निष्कर्ष सार्वजनिक हों तो सशर्त सहमति संभव है।
dialogue.r: samīkṣā ke niṣkarṣ sārvajanik hõ to saśart sahmati saṃbhav hai.
dialogue.en: Conditional agreement is possible if the review findings are public.

dialogue.t: समय-सीमा बनी रहे तो यह समझौता-प्रस्ताव हमें स्वीकार है।
dialogue.r: samay-sīmā banī rahe to yah samjhautā-prastāv hamẽ svīkār hai.
dialogue.en: The compromise is acceptable to us if the deadline remains.

dialogue.t: कार्यवृत्त में दोनों शर्तें और शेष असहमति दर्ज होंगी; इसे सर्वसम्मति नहीं कहेंगे।
dialogue.r: kāryavṛtt mẽ donõ śartẽ aur śeṣ asahmati darj hõgī; ise sarvasammati nahī̃ kahẽge.
dialogue.en: The minutes will record both conditions and remaining dissent; we will not call it consensus.

practice.q: Does सशर्त सहमति equal consensus?
practice.answer: No; conditions or dissent remain.

practice.q: Formal minutes: दो हितधारकों ने असहमति ___.
practice.answer: दर्ज की

practice.q: Order negotiation: interests, options, conditions, accurate record.
practice.answer: interests → options → conditions → accurate record

practice.q: Record formally: “We agree only if the findings are public.”
practice.answer: निष्कर्ष सार्वजनिक किए जाने की शर्त पर सशर्त सहमति दी गई।

practice.q: Close a presentation with purpose, limitation, and next action.
practice.answer: संक्षेप में, प्रस्ताव जवाबदेही बढ़ा सकता है। लागत का स्वतंत्र सत्यापन अभी शेष है; अतः सत्यापन के बाद अंतिम निर्णय लिया जाए।

quiz.why: हितधारक means stakeholder in this lesson.

quiz.why: सशर्त सहमति means conditional agreement.

quiz.q: Which expression means “consensus”?
quiz.why: सर्वसम्मति carries that meaning.

options: meaning, evidence, or register in context

Interpret precisely: नौ दो ग्यारह होना (nau do gyārah honā)
Explain the commitment difference among suggest, show, and prove in Hindi.
items.answer: सुझाना संभावित निष्कर्ष देता है; दर्शाना उसे स्पष्ट साक्ष्य से सामने रखता है; सिद्ध करना निर्णायक प्रमाण का दावा करता है।

items.q: Explain how moving ही changes focus in two Hindi examples.
items.answer: समिति ने ही कहा focuses who spoke; समिति ने यही कहा focuses what was said.

items.q: Respond to a strong cost objection without caricaturing it.
items.answer: प्रारंभिक लागत संबंधी आपत्ति उचित है। तथापि चरणबद्ध कार्यान्वयन से जोखिम सीमित किया जा सकता है; इसलिए पहले नियंत्रित परीक्षण की अनुशंसा है।
